outcome: treatment success rate of repeated Misoprostol
cohort: Patients with ultrasound-proven intrauterine abnormal pregnancy, treated for missed abortion or blighted ovum by two doses of intravaginal Misoprostol, were included in this study.
finding: The overall success rate of a repeated Misoprostol course was 47.4%, with a significantly higher success rate observed in symptomatic women (64.3%).
